profile.headline: Software Developer
profile.summary:
- Graduated from San Jose State University in Software Engineering Dec 2018.
- Interned at Shutterfly Inc.
- Hands-on industrial experience in Java, MySQL, DB2, GIT, SVN, CVS. Open to learning any language or platform.
- Adept in software development methodologies. 
- An enthusiastic, quick learner, meticulous individual with strong analytical, debugging, problem-solving skills. 
- Ability to work independently and autonomous environment.
- Strong knowledge of object-oriented programming language, Data Structures, and MVC architecture. 
- Looking to secure a challenging position to utilize my skills to deliver high-quality products and exceed company business goals.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Skills: Distributed Systems · Java · MySQL · Elasticsearch · Git · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Spring Boot · Jira · Scrum · Cassandra · Microservices · Databases · Spring Framework · REST APIs · Data Structures

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• My responsibilities include providing software development in support application level API
• Designing and building systems to monitor orders flow in the application platform and managing associated alerts
•  Collaborate with cross functional team to design and Develop backorder analysis system for orders across company website, to find out reasons of backorders and how to reduce the impact by categorization on reason codes including service failure, not having enough inventory, timeout exception & internal failure
• Automating alerts on the infrastructure to keep system in control, put together failure rollover mechanism
• Evaluating new product environment and build the infrastructure as DevOps engineer for version control
• Designing user friendly interface to check monitor health of the system deployed including computes, database, website failure points
• Automating kafka lag alerts to prevent update delay
• Understand various distributed system implementation and data storage and managing systems, parallel data processing frameworks, RESTful architecture, and orchestration systems and be able to make a good technical decision given particular data engineering needs and technical requirements.
• Implement a data pipeline feature that will automatically monitor various task metrics, pipeline status, performance metrics, and visualize them in a user-friendly manner
• Practicing in agile object-oriented software engineering methods in collaboration with the team and implement software best practices to become a proficient software engineer
• Building API for reprocessing error flow, to reduce queue load and distributing evenly
• Preprocessing data of pending orders and providing timely update to customer, supporting issues for which manual efforts required 
• Creating standalone application for grocery cutoff monitoring, reports manager, compute action monitor, express delivery orders flow monitoring
positions.insights: Skills: Distributed Systems · Java · Apache Kafka · Elasticsearch · Jenkins · Git · JMeter · Spring Boot · Jira · Scrum · Databases · Spring Framework · Data Structures · CI/CD

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Developing REST web services to expose Middleware services. 
•	Diverse experience utilizing tools in N-tier and Microservices architecture applications using Spring Boot, AWS, My SQL, Restful Web Services.
•	Utilizing agile methodology for design/ development, preparing project plan, and test plans
•	Implementing design patterns such as delegator, singleton and other patterns
•	Implemented applications using Java Technologies (Java Web Services, JDK, Java, JPA, JDBC, JSON, JavaScript, HTML5, API, and Hibernate.
•	Formulating technical strategy with various functional areas across application
•	Implementing persistence to the database using the JPA queries.
•	Developing front end pages using HTML/CSS/JS.
•	Using Java Lambda expressions and Stream API to support functional-style operations on streams of elements.
•	Design and use of RESTfull web services
•	Working on Java8, developed several API's as per the business cases and analyses the current API with SpringBoot.
positions.insights: Skills: Git · Jira · Scrum · Databases · Spring Framework · Data Structures

positions.title: Internship Trainee
positions.description:
•	Worked on enhancement of UI to improve user experience with the help of JavaScript
•	Worked on test automation using selenium with Java 
•	Created endpoints for user recommendation using backtracking of user search and purchase history
•	Involved in the pricing calculation for the customer history page.
•	Created end points for order history and details page using microservice architecture.
•	Created UI component using React.
•	Translated UI wireframe to responsive elements.
•	Involved in the Sprint Planning, deciding Story and ticket priorities.
•	Developing application design guidance and consultation, utilizing a thorough understanding of applicable technology, tools and existing designs.
•	Designed and implemented RESTful APIs based on Spring Boot.
•	Wrote the controller in Spring Boot which delegates the request from front end to the delegator layer and to make calls with backend systems
•	Conducted Code Reviews.
•	Managed source control and version control using GIT
•	Project status tracking using JIRA
•	Experienced in problem analysis in both technical system and application programs.
•	Essentially involved in all phases of SDLC to structure the unformatted requirements.
positions.insights: Skills: Git · Jira · Scrum · Databases · Spring Framework · Data Structures

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Worked as a Java Application Developer in an Agile environment for FedEx and DTNA. 
•	Worked on Freight Workbench application which provided load balancing, dangerous goods optimization and goods allocations to minimize the risk factor; saved  manual effort time by 47% for cargo airplanes
•	Translated requirements into technical specs, designed and developed features for Freight Workbench application in an agile environment approach
•	Worked with customers to identify, isolate and resolve customer issues and debug software
•	Automated unit testing process by developing a standalone application with report generating features
•	Manual and automated testing of online and mobile retail applications
•	Wrote test plans and use cases for UI and Rest APIs

positions.title: Consultant
positions.description:
- Worked as a consultant to gain knowledge on business and agile development processes. 
- Wrote test scripts in Java using Selenium to test Microsoft Azure.

educations.schoolName: Sinhagad Technical Education Society'S College Of Engineering

projects.title: Ticket Booking and Management System for CalTrain
projects.description:
•	Designed and developed a ticket booking and management system for CalTrain.
•	System capabilities include Search for trains, book tickets, User management, Booking History,  Ticket Cancellation, Train Cancellation, Search and Booking reports.
Technical Stack: Spring Boot, JPA, Firebase, AWS S3, JavaScript

projects.title: Cross Domain Market Place
projects.description:
Designed and implemented an Universal Market Place in PHP and MySQL to provide feature-rich online shopping experience. The website utilized various RESTFul APIs like Google Plus and Twitter login, Facebook for sharing.

Responsibilities:
Designed individual website for managing cross platform with AWS hosting and GoDaddy domain provider, http://blazefocus.com .
Managed database implementation for Marketplace.
Handled user profile across the marketplace.
